name: InitMpegLibrary
evidence: the MPEG library's initialisation: resets the IPU (ResetIpu) (InitMoviePlayback calls it)

name: CreateMpegDecoder
evidence: sets up a decoder in a work area, reporting "The size of work area is too small" when it is, with its ring buffer and DMA hooks (InitMoviePlayback calls it)

name: DeleteMpegDecoder
evidence: returns 1 (FinishMovie calls it)

name: DecodeMpegPicture
evidence: sets the output address and size of a decoder and runs its picture loop (StepMovieFrame calls it)

name: GetMpegDecoderStatus
evidence: returns the first word of a decoder's state (PlayMovie reads it)

name: ResetMpegDecoder
evidence: clears a decoder's state words and its pictures' bookkeeping (FinishMovie and CreateMpegDecoder call it)

name: ReleaseMpegPictures
evidence: clears the word at +0x28 of each of the decoder's six picture pointers that is set

name: SetMpegCallback
evidence: stores a callback and its argument in a decoder's table at an index and returns the old one (InitMoviePlayback calls it)

name: RunMpegCallback
evidence: runs the decoder's callback for the kind a message names, with its argument

name: RunMpegStallCallback
evidence: runs the decoder's callback of kind 1; the IPU waits call it each time the IPU stays busy too long

name: InitMpegRing
evidence: sets a ring buffer's start, size, read and write positions

name: AllocateFromMpegRing
evidence: takes an aligned block of a size from a decoder's ring buffer, reporting an error when it does not fit

name: RunMpegPictureLoop
evidence: the decoder's picture loop: parses headers and decodes pictures until a picture is out or the stream ends (DecodeMpegPicture calls it)

name: PrintMpegError
evidence: prints a message after "[MPEG ERROR]"

name: ReportMpegErrorFormat
evidence: formats a message into a buffer and reports it with ReportMpegError

name: ReportMpegError
evidence: hands a message to the decoder's callback of kind 0, or prints it with PrintMpegError when there is none

name: ReadSequenceHeader
evidence: reads a sequence header and its extensions (ParseMpegHeaders calls it on the start code 0x1B3)

name: RejectSequenceScalableExtension
evidence: reports "_sequenceScalableExtension() is not implemented"

name: RejectUnknownExtension
evidence: reports "Unknown Extension"

name: RejectSpatialScalableExtension
evidence: reports "_pictureSpatialScalableExtension is not supported"

name: RejectTemporalScalableExtension
evidence: reports "_pictureTemporalScalableExtension is not supported"

name: SaveMpegDmaState
evidence: saves the IPU's two DMA channels before a picture (SaveIpuDmaChannels); a decoder's hook

name: RestoreMpegDmaState
evidence: restores the IPU's two DMA channels after a picture (RestoreIpuDmaChannels); a decoder's hook
